summary.ko: 아인트호벤 Strijp-S의 실제 105세대 주거복합입니다. 환기·전기·급배수 원본 모델을 레이어로 제공합니다. 외피 분류가 확인되지 않아 에너지 등급은 산정하지 않습니다.
summary.en: A real 105-apartment complex at Strijp-S, Eindhoven, published by its contractor. Ventilation, electrical and plumbing ship as source layers. Exterior-envelope classification is unresolved, so no energy rating is calculated.

attribution: Stam + De Koning, "Sixty5" (developed as Building Field S1), Strijp-S, Eindhoven. Published in the buildingSMART Community Sample Test Files under CC BY 4.0; extracted and adapted by BIMFIT. https://github.com/buildingsmart-community/Community-Sample-Test-Files

counts.externalElementsNote: 113 external physical space boundaries exist and none resolved: swept curve is not a readable polyline. The classifier reads IfcSurfaceOfLinearExtrusion (Revit); this file's boundaries are another surface type. Envelope areas here come from the wall walk, not from boundaries, so nothing published depends on this.

areas.openingsNote: Glazing aperture 0 m² = 0 IfcWindow at OverallWidth × OverallHeight (0 m²). Exterior doors are separate — a door is aperture, not glazing: 0 IfcDoor, 0 m², OverallWidth × OverallHeight. Host wall by IfcRelFillsElement → IfcOpeningElement → IfcRelVoidsElement (0 openings). Sector is the host wall's, from the same orientation pass as the wall split. No conditioned space solids to probe, so envelope rests on the host wall alone; 246 openings hosted in walls outside the exterior set; 632 window(s) (816.52 m²) and 808 door(s) (2075.49 m²) sit in the plane of walls outside the exterior-wall set and are not counted — the wall names are on each row; 213 unresolved (306.87 m² where a size is stated). IsExternal is reported per row and never used as a filter — it means "not an interior partition" to an authoring tool, never "bounds conditioned space against outdoor air". areas.volumeNote: Gross from 0 spaces (floor area × storey height; voids, and rooms taller than their storey with no void above, as their own solids); net from 0 spaces (), KAVEL NR excluded. A closed tessellation's signed volume is exact.
areas.roofNote: Plan shadow per element (union of its projected triangles, ifc-plan-shadow.mjs): 0 elements — . roofProjectedSqm sums 0 roof type(s), each as the union of its elements; the elements themselves sum to 0 m² (elements of one type overlapping in plan) and all types together cover 0 m² (one type above another). surfaceSqm is each element's true one-sheet surface (Σ area of its upward faces; ÷ 2 where a surface model has no downward face and both sheets are wound upward; ÷ the coverage where its parts cover its shadow more than once, as stacked layer solids do — surfaceBasis says which), summing to 0 m²; a flat deck's surface equals its shadow, a pitched roof's exceeds it. Source slab geometry is displayed. An absence of ROOF-typed entities is not evidence of no roof; roof classification remains unresolved.
areas.groundNote: IfcSlab (not ROOF or LANDING) on storeys at or below 00 begane grond (0 m): 29 candidate(s). architecturalDetails.triangleCountBasis: triangleCount stores each instanced shape once; placedTriangleCount includes every placement
architecturalDetails.appearance: web-ifc tessellator RGBA, including possible default styles; no inferred finish textures. Metalness 0 and roughness 0.85 are renderer assumptions, not measured material properties.
architecturalDetails.note: Selected source IFC entity classes omitted from the core fabric layer. Original tessellated geometry and placements; repeated shapes use GPU instancing. Not a claim of complete architectural or fabrication detail. Existing services remain separate.

summary.ko: 공개된 환기·전기·급배수 IFC를 각각 표시합니다. 원본의 주방·외피 모델은 포함하지 않았습니다. IfcSpace는 세대 구획 표시용 1 m² 주석이라 바닥면적으로 집계하지 않으며, 모델 간 중복 가능성이 있어 원본 요소 수를 설치 설비의 고유 개수로 해석하지 않습니다.
summary.en: Published ventilation, electrical and plumbing IFCs are shown separately. The source's kitchen and facade models were not taken. Its IfcSpace entities are 1 m² plot-number annotations rather than rooms, so they are not summed as floor area. Source occurrence counts can overlap between models and are not unique installed equipment counts.

limitations.ko: 해시로 고정된 IFC 파일에서 해당 스키마의 설비 분류 상속을 확인한 요소 목록이며, 실제 설치 설비의 완전성 조사가 아닙니다.
limitations.en: Inventory of distribution occurrence classes using each pinned IFC file's schema inheritance, not a completeness survey of installed services.

limitations.ko: 분야별·수정본 모델 간 요소가 중복될 수 있으며 파일 간 설비 중복 제거는 하지 않았습니다.
limitations.en: Counts include overlapping discipline and revision models; there is no cross-file equipment deduplication.

limitations.ko: 일반 IfcBuildingElementProxy·IfcFurnishingElement는 원본 근거 없이 MEP로 분류하지 않습니다.
limitations.en: Generic IfcBuildingElementProxy and IfcFurnishingElement occurrences are not classified as MEP without source evidence.

model.note: Source fabric tessellation of the architectural discipline model. Ventilation, electrical and plumbing ship as their own layers. The source's kitchen and facade models were not taken. No energy baseline is calculated: exterior-envelope classification is unresolved for this model.
model.serviceNote: Service layers carry every component at the model's own geometry; a repeated shape is stored once and placed by instancing.

invalidDiagnostics.note: No space-boundary strips resolved in this file; there is no sum to refute.
